newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 364-day T-bill yields 19.20 pct at auction.
newsitem.headline: Russia 364-day T-bill yields 19.20 pct at auction.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 364-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 19.20 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average yield would be in the 19.07-19.84 percent range.
The series 21078 bill, maturing on July 7, 1998, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 84.35 percent to yield 19.19 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
On Wednesday the Finance Ministry will also offer 10.00 trillion roubles in an additional tranche of OFZ interest-bearing bonds (series 24015).

It will pay 361.7 billion roubles in interest and repay up to 4.81 trillion roubles of tax-exempt series 24008 bonds on a voluntary basis. It will also repay 7.48 trillion roubles of maturing 161-day T-bills (series 22069).
